test_title: PYST 33: SSC MTS - English (Held on: 19 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been divided into parts. One of them may contain an error. Select the part that contains the error from the given options. If you don’t find any error, mark ‘No error’ as your answer.

Their are numerous / buildings outside our / school premises.
solution:
The erroneous part is: **Their are numerous**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is incorrect because it contains **subject-verb agreement **errors and incorrect use of prepositions.
 
• Firstly, ""their"" is a **possessive adjective** and cannot be used as the subject of the sentence. (Thiers- possessive pronoun)
 
• The correct subject should be ""there,"" which refers to a place or location.

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***There__ are numerous buildings outside our school premises.***
